title: The New Speaker Avoided a Shutdown. Can He Avoid Being Ousted?

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来一直致力于帮助您了解世界，并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: By working with Democrats to avert a government shutdown at the end of last week, the new Republican House Speaker, Mike Johnson,
sentences.zh: 通过与民主党人合作，在上周末避免了政府停摆，新任共和党众议院议长迈克·约翰逊，

sentences.en: seemed to put himself on the same path of self-immolation that doomed his predecessor.
sentences.zh: 似乎走上了与他前任相同的自毁之路。

sentences.en: Or did he?
sentences.zh: 真的是这样吗？

sentences.en: My colleague, Katie Edmondson, on why this time, things could be different.
sentences.zh: 我的同事凯蒂·埃德蒙森将为您解析，为什么这一次情况可能会有所不同。

sentences.en: It's Monday, November 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月20日，星期一。

sentences.en: So Katie, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么凯蒂，美国

sentences.en: government did not shut down over the past few days, as many had feared that it might or would, especially given the dysfunction we have observed and talked to you about endlessly
sentences.zh: 政府在过去几天里并没有停摆，尽管许多人担心它可能会或将会停摆，特别是考虑到过去一年里我们观察到并不断与你讨论的

sentences.en: from this Republican-controlled House over the past year.
sentences.zh: 这个由共和党控制的众议院所表现出的功能失调。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Congress was staring down this deadline at midnight last Friday.
sentences.zh: 国会正面临上周五午夜的最后期限。

sentences.en: Government funding was set to expire unless Congress came to some sort of deal to keep the government funded.
sentences.zh: 除非国会达成某种协议来维持政府资金，否则政府拨款即将到期。

sentences.en: And there were a lot of questions as to whether Congress would be able to make that happen.
sentences.zh: 当时有很多疑问，国会是否能够做到这一点。

sentences.en: They were working on a very short time frame, in large part because House Republicans really wasted three weeks trying to elect a new speaker.
sentences.zh: 他们的时间非常紧迫，很大程度上是因为众议院共和党人确实浪费了三周时间来选举新议长。

sentences.en: And then there were a lot of questions about what that new speaker,
sentences.zh: 然后，关于这位新议长，

sentences.en: Speaker Mike Johnson, would do once he got the job to try to avert a shutdown.
sentences.zh: 议长迈克·约翰逊，在上任后会采取什么行动来试图避免停摆，也存在很多疑问。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the fact that there wasn't a shutdown was very much the work of this new House speaker.
sentences.zh: 事实上，没有发生停摆很大程度上是这位新任众议院议长的功劳。

sentences.en: So, in brief, what did we learn about Speaker Mike Johnson from the fact that there wasn't a shutdown?
sentences.zh: 那么，简而言之，从没有发生停摆这件事上，我们对议长迈克·约翰逊了解到了什么？

sentences.en: I think the first thing that we learned is that Mike Johnson as speaker operates differently, at least so far, than Mike Johnson, the rank-and-file member, did.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们学到的第一件事是，作为议长的迈克·约翰逊，至少到目前为止，其行事方式与作为普通议员的迈克·约翰逊不同。

sentences.en: So if you remember back in September, Kevin McCarthy, really the last major thing he did as speaker was to pass this deal to keep the government funded
sentences.zh: 如果你还记得九月份，凯文·麦卡锡作为议长做的最后一件大事，就是通过了这项维持政府资金的协议，

sentences.en: through this November deadline.
sentences.zh: 一直持续到十一月的最后期限。

sentences.en: And he used Democratic votes to do that.
sentences.zh: 他利用了民主党的投票来做到这一点。

sentences.en: And that was a deal that Mike Johnson opposed.
sentences.zh: 而那正是迈克·约翰逊所反对的协议。

sentences.en: He voted against keeping the government open back in September.
sentences.zh: 他在九月份投票反对维持政府运作。

sentences.en: Fast forward to November.
sentences.zh: 快进到十一月。

sentences.en: Now he's speaker.
sentences.zh: 现在他是议长了。

sentences.en: He chose, in this case, to rise above his own hard-right ideology and to instead make the decision to keep the government open and to use Democrats, in fact, to do that.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，他选择超越自己极右翼的意识形态，转而做出维持政府运作的决定，事实上，他还利用了民主党人来实现这一目标。

sentences.en: And I think the second thing that we learned is that in doing so, he has invoked the ire of the Freedom Caucus in such a way that puts him on potentially a similar collision course
sentences.zh: 我认为我们学到的第二件事是，他这样做激怒了“自由核心小组”，这使他可能走上了与

sentences.en: to what former Speaker Kevin McCarthy found himself on at the very beginning of his job with those hard-right Republicans.
sentences.zh: 前议长凯文·麦卡锡在任职初期与那些极右翼共和党人发生冲突时相似的道路。

sentences.en: Because even though Mike Johnson really was considered one of the Freedom Caucus' own,
sentences.zh: 因为尽管迈克·约翰逊确实被认为是“自由核心小组”自己人，

sentences.en: the Freedom Caucus obviously was very unhappy to see Mike Johnson pass this short-term spending bill with Democratic votes.
sentences.zh: 但“自由核心小组”显然对看到迈克·约翰逊利用民主党的投票通过这项短期支出法案感到非常不满。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So tell us the story of what happened during this almost-government shutdown that was averted that helps really explain these two learnings that you just laid out.
sentences.zh: 那么，请给我们讲讲这次差点导致政府停摆但最终被避免的事件经过，这有助于解释你刚才提到的这两点发现。

sentences.en: Well, when Mike Johnson is elected speaker, he automatically inherits all of the spending drama that eventually led to the ouster of Kevin McCarthy.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当迈克·约翰逊当选议长时，他自动继承了最终导致凯文·麦卡锡被罢免的所有支出闹剧。

sentences.en: And so the first question really was, how is this completely untested speaker going to handle this?
sentences.zh: 所以第一个问题确实是，这位完全未经考验的议长将如何处理这个问题？

sentences.en: And the first move that we saw Speaker Mike Johnson make was, if you remember, the Israel funding bill that he put on the House floor.
sentences.zh: 我们看到议长迈克·约翰逊采取的第一个行动是，如果你还记得的话，就是他提交到众议院的以色列援助法案。

sentences.en: And that was a really partisan measure.
sentences.zh: 那是一项非常具有党派色彩的措施。

sentences.en: He didn't advance legislation just to send aid to Israel.
sentences.zh: 他不仅仅是为了向以色列提供援助而推进立法。

sentences.en: He structured it in a way that said, well, in order to send this money, we're going to cut a bunch of money that the Biden administration wanted for the IRS.
sentences.zh: 他的结构设计是这样的：为了拨出这笔钱，我们将削减拜登政府想要给国税局的一大笔资金。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: A clear signal that his approach to this job as Speaker, right off the bat, was very partisan, very much about, like, sticking it to the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 这是一个明确的信号，表明他作为议长处理这份工作的方式，从一开始就非常具有党派色彩，非常倾向于给民主党人制造麻烦。

sentences.en: That was the first message that he sent.
sentences.zh: 那是他发出的第一个信息。

sentences.en: And so the first indication was, well, maybe this is someone who is, on every important move, going to nod to the hard right flank of the party that he came from.
sentences.zh: 因此，第一个迹象表明，也许他是一个在每一个重要举措上，都会向他出身的党内极右翼派系点头的人。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So that's the impression we have of Johnson heading into this extremely high-stakes question of, will the government shut down?
sentences.zh: 这就是我们在面对“政府会停摆吗？”这个极其高风险的问题时，对约翰逊的印象。

sentences.en: So how does he approach it?
sentences.zh: 那么他是如何处理的呢？

sentences.en: What happens?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, so he actually pulls a page from Kevin McCarthy's playbook, and that is by taking a lot of meetings with the various factions of the House Republican Conference.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他实际上借鉴了凯文·麦卡锡的策略，那就是与众议院共和党会议的各个派系进行了多次会谈。

sentences.en: So he heard a lot of varying opinions.
sentences.zh: 所以他听取了许多不同的意见。

sentences.en: There were some Republicans within the House Freedom Caucus who said, let's have the shutdown.
sentences.zh: 众议院“自由核心小组”内有一些共和党人说，让政府停摆吧。

sentences.en: Let's force this discussion about how we have to cut spending.
sentences.zh: 让我们强行讨论我们必须如何削减开支。

sentences.en: And if that requires us to just shut the whole place down, so be it.
sentences.zh: 如果这需要我们让整个政府停摆，那就这样吧。

sentences.en: Chip Roy said, I'll eat my Thanksgiving dinner on the floor of the House and have this discussion.
sentences.zh: 奇普·罗伊说，我会在众议院大厅吃我的感恩节晚餐，并进行这场讨论。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is the group of Republicans who are basically saying, McCarthy didn't have the courage to
sentences.zh: 这群共和党人基本上是在说，麦卡锡没有勇气

sentences.en: do what needed to be done, so brand-new Speaker Johnson, you should do what he wouldn't, shut it down, take a stand, cut government spending at any coSt.
sentences.zh: 去做需要做的事，所以全新的议长约翰逊，你应该做他不敢做的事，让它停摆，表明立场，不惜一切代价削减政府开支。

sentences.en: Which would, we should note, be in line with how Mike Johnson acted for years.
sentences.zh: 我们应该注意到，这与迈克·约翰逊多年来的行为是一致的。

sentences.en: Yes, that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: And some of them were saying, well, let's pass a bill that has deep cuts in it.
sentences.zh: 他们中的一些人说，好吧，让我们通过一项包含深度削减的法案。

sentences.en: And when the Senate refuses to take it up, as we know they will, because Democrats don't want to support those types of deep spending cuts, right, then let's blame them for the
sentences.zh: 当参议院拒绝审议时，正如我们所知他们会那样做，因为民主党人不想支持那种深度的支出削减，对吧，那么我们就把

sentences.en: shutdown.
sentences.zh: 停摆的责任归咎于他们。

sentences.en: Now, of course, he hears an entirely different message from the moderates who tell him, of course, we cannot have a shutdown, especially right before Thanksgiving.
sentences.zh: 现在，当然，他从温和派那里听到了完全不同的信息，他们告诉他，当然，我们不能让政府停摆，特别是在感恩节之前。

sentences.en: It's going to look terrible if we just spent three weeks fighting among ourselves, unable to elect a Speaker, and the next thing we do is shut down the government.
sentences.zh: 如果我们花了三周时间在内部争斗，无法选出议长，而接下来做的第一件事就是让政府停摆，那看起来会非常糟糕。

sentences.en: And then there's a final group of players that he's talking with, and that's over in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 然后还有最后一批他正在对话的参与者，那就是在参议院那边。

sentences.en: And he checks in with Senator Chuck Schumer, the majority leader over in the Senate, and
sentences.zh: 他与参议院多数党领袖查克·舒默进行了沟通，

sentences.en: Chuck Schumer tells him, in order for any sort of funding mechanism to be signed into law, it has to be bipartisan.
sentences.zh: 查克·舒默告诉他，为了让任何形式的拨款机制签署成为法律，它必须是两党共同支持的。

sentences.en: You have to work with us, because that is the reality of this government.
sentences.zh: 你必须与我们合作，因为这就是本届政府的现实。

sentences.en: Let's keep government open, and we'll work with you.
sentences.zh: 让我们保持政府运作，我们会与你合作。

sentences.en: So after hearing from all these various factions, what do we know about what Johnson is thinking at this particular juncture?
sentences.zh: 那么在听取了所有这些不同派系的意见后，我们对约翰逊在这一特定时刻的想法了解多少？

sentences.en: Well, we really didn't know that much about how he was thinking about this.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们确实不太了解他是如何考虑这个问题的。

sentences.en: And we would talk to the lawmakers after these meetings, and they would say, you know, he
sentences.zh: 我们在这些会议后会与议员们交谈，他们会说，你知道，他

sentences.en: listened to us a lot, but even we don't really have a sense exactly of what he might be planning to do.
sentences.zh: 听取了我们很多意见，但即使是我们，也真的不知道他到底打算做什么。

sentences.en: And so as we kept getting closer and closer to the deadline, and we weren't receiving any sorts of leaks or sort of glimmers of how he might approach this, there was really
sentences.zh: 所以随着我们越来越接近最后期限，而我们没有收到任何泄露的消息，也没有任何关于他可能如何处理此事的迹象，我认为对于每个人来说，

sentences.en: a sense of suspense building, I think, for everyone, because he kept getting closer to this deadline and did not have really any visibility on how he might try to get out of it.
sentences.zh: 悬念感都在不断增加，因为他越来越接近最后期限，却没有任何关于他可能如何试图摆脱困境的可见信息。

sentences.en: Okay, so when do you finally get a leak or a glimmer?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么你们最终是在什么时候得到泄露或迹象的？

sentences.en: Well, in classic congressional fashion, Speaker Johnson holds a conference call with his members
sentences.zh: 嗯，以典型的国会方式，议长约翰逊与他的成员举行了一次电话会议，

sentences.en: where he tells them the bill that he is going to put on the House floor to keep the government funded is not going to have any spending cuts.
sentences.zh: 他在会上告诉他们，他将提交到众议院以维持政府资金的法案不会包含任何支出削减。

sentences.en: It will not be conditioned on any conservative policies being passed into law.
sentences.zh: 它不会以任何保守派政策被写入法律为前提条件。

sentences.en: So what he unveils to his conference is essentially just a bill that is going to keep government funding flowing into early next year.
sentences.zh: 所以他向他的党团披露的本质上只是一个将维持政府资金流向明年年初的法案。

sentences.en: Now, he did throw a bone, essentially a very small bone, to the House Freedom Caucus with this
sentences.zh: 现在，他确实给众议院“自由核心小组”扔了一根骨头，本质上是一根非常小的骨头，

sentences.en: plan in that the way he structures this bill funds the government essentially in two steps.
sentences.zh: 因为他构建该法案的方式基本上分两步为政府提供资金。

sentences.en: And so in order to keep the government funded again in early 2024, lawmakers will have to take
sentences.zh: 因此，为了在2024年初再次维持政府资金，议员们将不得不

sentences.en: one vote to fund some parts of the government in late January, and then they'll have to take a second vote to fund the rest of it a couple weeks later in February.
sentences.zh: 进行一次投票，在1月底为政府的部分部门提供资金，然后他们必须在几周后的2月份进行第二次投票，为剩余部分提供资金。

sentences.en: And the reason why he structured it this way is that the House Freedom Caucus for years really has
sentences.zh: 他这样构建的原因是，众议院“自由核心小组”多年来确实

sentences.en: complained about the idea that they've had to vote to fund the government in one up or down vote.
sentences.zh: 抱怨他们必须通过一次赞成或反对的投票来为政府提供资金的想法。

sentences.en: And so this breaks that in two, that takes away that grievance.
sentences.zh: 所以这把它分成了两部分，消除了那个不满。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, this is still a clean spending bill that he's advancing.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，这仍然是一个他正在推进的纯粹的支出法案。

sentences.en: Which is very hard for them to accept.
sentences.zh: 这对他们来说非常难以接受。

sentences.en: It is pretty much a replica of what Kevin McCarthy put on the floor back in September that angered the Freedom Caucus so much that they moved to oust him.
sentences.zh: 这几乎是凯文·麦卡锡在九月份提交的法案的翻版，该法案激怒了“自由核心小组”，以至于他们采取行动罢免了他。

sentences.en: OK, so what happens when Johnson does this?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么当约翰逊这样做时发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, the conference call was still continuing when one influential conservative
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，电话会议还在进行中，一位有影响力的保守派人士，

sentences.en: Chip Roy of Texas took to Twitter to say that he would oppose the plan.
sentences.zh: 来自德克萨斯州的奇普·罗伊，就在推特上表示他将反对该计划。

sentences.en: You know, normally people wait at least until the conference call is over to announce their opposition, but I think that gives you a sense of how angry people were.
sentences.zh: 你知道，通常人们至少会等到电话会议结束后才宣布反对，但我认为这让你了解人们有多愤怒。

sentences.en: And I think, honestly, some of the Freedom Caucus members were really surprised that Mike
sentences.zh: 而且老实说，我认为一些“自由核心小组”成员对迈克·约翰逊采取这种策略感到非常惊讶，因为，再次强调，在他们心目中，他是他们的一员。

sentences.en: Johnson took this tack because, again, in their mind, he's one of them.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他们原本期待看到一些更符合他们意愿的东西。

sentences.en: And so I think they were expecting to see something that hewed closer to what they wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 所以问题就变成了，这是民主党人会支持的东西吗？

sentences.en: So then the question becomes, is this something that Democrats will support?
sentences.zh: 因为显然共和党人对该计划的反对票数正在大量堆积，

sentences.en: Because clearly the number of Republican defections to this plan are stacking up in such large numbers
sentences.zh: 以至于我们知道民主党人将是众议院通过该法案所必需的。

sentences.en: that we know Democrats are going to be required to pass this on the House floor.
sentences.zh: 所以我们最初听到民主党人对此有一些抱怨，其中一些是作秀。

sentences.en: And so we initially hear some grumbling from Democrats on this, and some of it is showmanship.
sentences.zh: 但坦率地说，其中很多也是实质性的。

sentences.en: But a lot of it also, frankly, is substantive.
sentences.zh: 他们对该法案设定的两个拨款截止日期感到非常沮丧。

sentences.en: And they are really frustrated by the two funding deadlines that this bill lays out.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，我们听到一些民主党人说出了心里话，那就是：

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, we hear some Democrats saying the quiet part out loud, which is,
sentences.zh: 这对我们来说太棒了，因为没有削减开支，也没有附加任何保守派政策。

sentences.en: this is great for us because there's no spending cuts and there's no conservative policies attached to this.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们想要的。

sentences.en: This is exactly what we wanted.
sentences.zh: 众议院现在开会。

sentences.en: The House will be in order.
sentences.zh: 所以……

sentences.en: And so...

sentences.zh: 本次投票，赞成票为336票。

sentences.zh: 反对票为95票。

sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 事实上，除了两名议员外，每一位民主党人都支持它。

sentences.en: And in fact, every single Democrat, except two, supported it.
sentences.zh: 三分之二赞成，规则被暂停。

sentences.en: Two-thirds being in the affirmative, the rules are suspended.
sentences.zh: 法案获得通过。

sentences.en: The bill is passed.
sentences.zh: 如果没有异议，重新考虑的动议将被搁置。

sentences.en: And without objection, the motion to reconsider is laid on the table.
sentences.zh: 这意味着民主党人让这项共和党支出法案得以通过。

sentences.en: Which means Democrats put this Republican spending bill over the edge.
sentences.zh: 而约翰逊已经转型为一个能够在很大程度上实现两党合作的人。

sentences.en: And Johnson had been kind of transformed into someone capable of bipartisanship on a very meaningful scale.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 他选择了麦卡锡的路线，利用民主党人提供大部分选票来维持政府运作。

sentences.en: He chose the McCarthy route in using Democrats to supply the bulk of votes to keep the government open.
sentences.zh: 我想把它交给我们的议长，迈克·约翰逊。

sentences.en: I want to yield it to our speaker, Mike Johnson.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，史蒂夫。

sentences.en: Thank you, Steve.
sentences.zh: 我要感谢这个非凡的领导团队。

sentences.en: I want to thank this extraordinary leadership team.
sentences.zh: 他们做得非常出色。

sentences.en: They're doing a great job.
sentences.zh: 而且，我的意思是，这是他至少有所察觉或意识到的事情。

sentences.en: And, I mean, this is something that he is sensitive to or aware of, at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 我们看到这一点在他投票后不久在国会山举行的新闻发布会上表现出来。

sentences.en: And we see that manifest in a news conference that he has on Capitol Hill shortly after the vote.
sentences.zh: 福克斯新闻。

sentences.en: Fox.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 我的问题是，这对你的成员来说有多困难？

sentences.en: My question is, how hard itself has this been to your members?
sentences.zh: 因为他们说这本质上和导致凯文·麦卡锡下台的事情是一样的。

sentences.en: Because they said this is essentially the same thing that bounced Kevin McCarthy.
sentences.zh: 因为他们说这本质上和导致凯文·麦卡锡下台的事情是一样的。

sentences.en: A reporter says to him, look, you know, the arch conservatives are really unhappy with this decision that you've made.
sentences.zh: 一位记者对他说，你看，你知道，那些极右翼保守派对你做出的这个决定非常不满。

sentences.en: And Speaker Johnson actually kind of interrupts him and says, Chad, I'm one of the arch conservatives,
sentences.zh: 而议长约翰逊实际上打断了他，说道，查德，我本人就是极右翼保守派之一，

sentences.en: OK?
sentences.zh: 好吗？

sentences.en: And I want to cut spending right now.
sentences.zh: 我也想现在就削减开支。

sentences.en: And I would like to put policy writers on this.
sentences.zh: 我也想在这上面加入政策条款。

sentences.en: But when you have a three vote majority, as we do right now, we don't have the votes to be able to advance that right now.
sentences.zh: 但正如我们现在这样，只有三个席位的微弱多数，我们目前没有足够的票数来推进这些。

sentences.en: So what we need to do is...
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要做的是……

sentences.en: It's just that the math didn't work here.
sentences.zh: 只是目前的票数算不过来。

sentences.en: This is the only way for me to keep the government open and funded.
sentences.zh: 这是我维持政府运作并获得拨款的唯一途径。

sentences.en: I've been at the job less than three weeks, right?
sentences.zh: 我上任还不到三周，对吧？

sentences.en: I can't change.
sentences.zh: 我无法改变。

sentences.en: I can't turn an aircraft carrier overnight.
sentences.zh: 我不可能一夜之间让航空母舰掉头。

sentences.en: But this was a very important first step to get us to the next stage.
sentences.zh: 但这确实是让我们进入下一阶段非常重要的第一步。

sentences.en: But for those arch conservatives, that's not really a satisfying answer.
sentences.zh: 但对于那些极右翼保守派来说，这并不是一个令人满意的答案。

sentences.en: And so the question for them becomes, can they believe Speaker Johnson when he says to them, look, I'm still one of you guys.
sentences.zh: 因此，对他们来说问题变成了，当约翰逊议长对他们说“看，我依然是你们的一员”时，他们还能相信他吗？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的《Connections》谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的这些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: So Katie, if you are a student of this Republican-controlled House and this moment in American
sentences.zh: 那么凯蒂，如果你是这个共和党控制的众议院以及当前美国

sentences.en: politics, the logical repercussions of what Speaker Johnson did in working with Democrats to avoid a government shutdown is that some far-right House member walks out onto the
sentences.zh: 政治时刻的研究者，约翰逊议长为了避免政府停摆而与民主党合作，其逻辑后果就是会有极右翼众议员走到

sentences.en: floor, hits the ejection button, and begins a process of basically ending Johnson's speakership.
sentences.zh: 议会大厅，按下弹射按钮，开启罢免约翰逊议长职位的程序。

sentences.en: So does it look in the hours and days after this shutdown is averted like Speaker Johnson's going to suffer that fate?
sentences.zh: 那么在这次停摆危机解除后的几个小时和几天里，约翰逊议长看起来会遭遇那种命运吗？

sentences.en: Well, we saw Freedom Caucus members come off the floor and reporters were rushing after them saying, well, you know, are you going to do it again?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们看到自由核心小组的成员走出议会大厅，记者们蜂拥而上问他们，好吧，你们知道的，你们还会再做一次吗？

sentences.en: Are you going to move to vacate him for this?
sentences.zh: 你们会因为这件事而动议罢免他吗？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And we heard a lot more sympathy for Mike Johnson from these ultra-conservative members than, you know, we ever heard them give to Kevin McCarthy.
sentences.zh: 我们听到这些极右翼成员对迈克·约翰逊表现出的同情，比我们以往听到他们对凯文·麦卡锡表现出的要多得多。

sentences.en: In fact, Matt Gaetz, who obviously was the lawmaker who successfully moved to oust Kevin
sentences.zh: 事实上，马特·盖茨，也就是那位成功动议罢免凯文·

sentences.en: McCarthy, he says, well, you know, everyone gets one mulligan.
sentences.zh: 麦卡锡的议员，他说，好吧，你知道，每个人都有一次犯错的机会。

sentences.en: We also hear from a number of Freedom Caucus members that they are unhappy with this decision, but they don't really begrudge Speaker Johnson personally.
sentences.zh: 我们也从一些自由核心小组成员那里听到，他们对这个决定不满，但他们并不真的在个人层面上怨恨约翰逊议长。

sentences.en: If you characterize it as a football game at the end of overtime down three touchdowns, right, that's when Johnson came in and you're trying to say, do you hold this quarterback
sentences.zh: 如果你把它比作一场橄榄球赛，在加时赛结束时落后三个达阵，对吧，约翰逊就是在那种情况下接手的，你想说的是，你对这位四分卫

sentences.en: to the same standard as the quarterback that got us to that point?
sentences.zh: 的要求，和对那位把我们带到这一步的四分卫是一样的吗？

sentences.en: No, we do not.
sentences.zh: 不，我们不这样要求。

sentences.en: Because after all, he's only been on the job for three weeks.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，他上任才三周。

sentences.en: He, it's like throwing in a quarterback in the fourth quarter and expecting to make up for three quarters of failure and you're behind 35-nothing.
sentences.zh: 他，这就像在第四节换上一名四分卫，却指望他能弥补前三节的失败，而且当时还落后35分。

sentences.en: So they're going to try to afford him a little bit more grace.
sentences.zh: 所以他们打算对他多一点宽容。

sentences.en: But why?
sentences.zh: 但为什么呢？

sentences.en: I mean, if he did the exact same thing, you might imagine them feeling that the betrayal is even deeper.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果他做了完全一样的事情，你可能会认为他们会觉得背叛感更深。

sentences.en: I mean, I just think it comes down to at the end of the day, they never really trusted Kevin
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我只是认为归根结底，他们从来没有真正信任过凯文·

sentences.en: McCarthy.
sentences.zh: 麦卡锡。

sentences.en: Was it worth, though, toppling McCarthy, giving you the same policy?
sentences.zh: 那么，推翻麦卡锡却得到同样的政策，这值得吗？

sentences.en: It's the same policy.
sentences.zh: 政策是一样的。

sentences.en: Worth it every day and twice on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 每天都值得，周日还要加倍。

sentences.en: At least he doesn't lie to us.
sentences.zh: 至少他不会对我们撒谎。

sentences.en: And they see Mike Johnson as someone who generally they have been able to truSt.
sentences.zh: 他们认为迈克·约翰逊是一个他们通常能够信任的人。

sentences.en: They generally see him as one of them.
sentences.zh: 他们普遍认为他是他们的一员。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But there also are some lawmakers who are really angry.
sentences.zh: 但也有一些议员确实非常愤怒。

sentences.en: We're too cowardly to stand up and do our job.
sentences.zh: 我们太懦弱了，不敢站出来履行我们的职责。

sentences.en: Oh, no, a shutdown.
sentences.zh: 哦，不，政府要停摆了。

sentences.en: Are you freaking kidding me?
sentences.zh: 你们是在开玩笑吗？

sentences.en: Representative Chip Roy of Texas, again, who is the first Republican member to come out against this plan, who couldn't even wait for the conference call to be done to contain
sentences.zh: 来自德克萨斯州的众议员奇普·罗伊，他又是第一位公开反对该计划的共和党成员，他甚至等不及电话会议结束就无法抑制

sentences.en: his rage, says that for him, Mike Johnson putting this plan on the floor amounts to strike one and strike two.
sentences.zh: 他的愤怒，他说对他而言，迈克·约翰逊把这个计划提交到议会大厅，相当于“一好球”和“二好球”。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: We went through an entire month of drama about a speaker.
sentences.zh: 我们经历了一个月的议长闹剧。

sentences.en: And we just did the same damn thing we've been doing.
sentences.zh: 结果我们做的还是我们一直在做的那些破事。

sentences.en: And we hear some Republicans who just say, look, we can't go on this way.
sentences.zh: 我们听到一些共和党人只是说，看，我们不能再这样下去了。

sentences.en: We cannot allow anyone, whether it's our friend Mike Johnson or someone else, to continue business as usual.
sentences.zh: 我们不能允许任何人，无论是我们的朋友迈克·约翰逊还是其他人，继续照常行事。

sentences.en: And do they start to, in any way, act on their anger at all?
sentences.zh: 那么他们会以任何方式对他们的愤怒采取行动吗？

sentences.en: We see them begin to act on their anger the very next day.
sentences.zh: 我们看到他们在第二天就开始对他们的愤怒采取行动了。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So part of the idea of advancing this short-term spending bill is to give Republicans in the
sentences.zh: 所以，推进这项短期支出法案的部分想法是给众议院的共和党人

sentences.en: House more time to pass their individual spending bills.
sentences.zh: 更多时间来通过他们各自的支出法案。

sentences.en: This was a big priority of the House Republican Conference, right?
sentences.zh: 这是众议院共和党会议的一个重要优先事项，对吧？

sentences.en: Let's not have the one up or down vote to fund the government.
sentences.zh: 不要再进行那种“要么通过要么否决”的政府拨款投票了。

sentences.en: Let's do it the old school way.
sentences.zh: 让我们用老派的方式来做。

sentences.en: And we are going to vote individually on 12 spending bills to fund all the government agencies.
sentences.zh: 我们将对12项支出法案进行单独投票，为所有政府机构提供资金。

sentences.en: Right, the kind of fantasy of Republicans doing it the old school way, actually passing appropriations bill, getting a budget done so that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 没错，共和党人那种用老派方式行事的幻想，即真正通过拨款法案，完成预算，这样美国

sentences.en: government doesn't lurch from shutdown crisis to shutdown crisis.
sentences.zh: 政府就不会在一次又一次的停摆危机中摇摆不定。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: And so the day after Mike Johnson passes the stopgap spending bill to avert the shutdown, he says, all right, you know, let's get back to what we said we were going to do.
sentences.zh: 所以，在迈克·约翰逊通过临时支出法案以避免停摆的第二天，他说，好吧，你知道，让我们回到我们说好要做的事情上来。

sentences.en: Let's try to advance one of these spending bills that funds the Justice Department, the Commerce Department, for example.
sentences.zh: 让我们尝试推进其中一项为司法部、商务部等提供资金的支出法案。

sentences.en: And what we see the House Freedom Caucus do is essentially tank the House's ability to pass that bill.
sentences.zh: 而我们看到众议院自由核心小组所做的，本质上是阻碍了众议院通过该法案的能力。

sentences.en: In a block, they all vote against this procedural step to allow a vote on the bill, and it brings the House to a crashing halt.
sentences.zh: 他们集体投票反对允许对该法案进行投票的程序性步骤，这使众议院陷入了瘫痪。

sentences.en: And this is a move that is really meant to be a very clear rebuke of Speaker Johnson.
sentences.zh: 这是一个旨在非常明确地斥责约翰逊议长的举动。

sentences.en: So they're voting against a spending bill that they themselves describe as a crucial priority in their efforts to make government function much better than it has and that embodies
sentences.zh: 所以他们投票反对一项他们自己描述为在努力使政府运作比以往更好、且体现了

sentences.en: conservative values.
sentences.zh: 保守派价值观方面至关重要的支出法案。

sentences.en: And they're basically just doing that to show Speaker Johnson how pissed off they are.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上只是为了向约翰逊议长展示他们有多么愤怒而这样做。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And if you want to get super technical about it, they're not even voting against the bill.
sentences.zh: 如果你想深究细节，他们甚至不是在投票反对该法案本身。

sentences.en: They're voting against letting the House consider the bill.
sentences.zh: 他们是在投票反对让众议院审议该法案。

sentences.en: And that's important just because in previous years, that was considered sort of a third rail.
sentences.zh: 这很重要，因为在过去几年里，这被认为是某种“禁区”。

sentences.en: It was just something that lawmakers didn't do.
sentences.zh: 这只是议员们不会做的事情。

sentences.en: But this has become actually a sort of tried and true method of bedeviling the House Speaker for the Freedom Caucus.
sentences.zh: 但这实际上已经成为自由核心小组折磨众议院议长的一种屡试不爽的方法。

sentences.en: And we know that because it is a playbook that they used on former Speaker Kevin McCarthy when
sentences.zh: 我们知道这一点，因为这是他们对前议长凯文·麦卡锡使用过的策略，当时

sentences.en: they were upset with him for putting bills on the House floor and passing them with Democratic votes.
sentences.zh: 他们对他将法案提交众议院并依靠民主党选票通过感到不满。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So if you're Speaker Johnson and you're seeing this tactic of torment used against McCarthy, used against you, you have to start thinking to yourself, there's literally a ticking
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是约翰逊议长，看到这种针对麦卡锡的折磨战术现在又用在你身上，你必须开始想，我的议长任期

sentences.en: clock now, potentially, on my speakership.
sentences.zh: 现在可能真的在倒计时了。

sentences.en: It is a pretty vivid example of deja vu.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常生动的似曾相识的例子。

sentences.en: And we saw Speaker Johnson, who normally is pretty placid, we saw him kind of storm off the House floor after that happened.
sentences.zh: 我们看到约翰逊议长，他通常相当平静，在事情发生后，我们看到他气冲冲地离开了众议院大厅。

sentences.en: And on his heels, in fact, were members of the House Freedom Caucus who came out to Statuary
sentences.zh: 事实上，紧随其后的是众议院自由核心小组的成员，他们来到雕像

sentences.en: Hall to tell us reporters, you know, we just put the Speaker on notice.
sentences.zh: 大厅告诉我们记者，你知道，我们刚刚向议长发出了警告。

sentences.en: So, Katie, that's where things were when the House went into recess for the Thanksgiving holiday, Johnson on thin ice with the far right, and the far right having basically said to
sentences.zh: 所以，凯蒂，这就是众议院进入感恩节假期休会时的情况，约翰逊在极右翼面前如履薄冰，而极右翼基本上已经对

sentences.en: Johnson, you are in our sights, be extremely careful.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊说，你已经在我们的视线之内了，务必极其小心。

sentences.en: So I want to start to project forward just a little bit, because the bill at the center of this drama we've been talking about only funds the government for a couple of months
sentences.zh: 所以我想稍微展望一下未来，因为我们一直在谈论的这场闹剧的核心法案只为政府提供了几个月的资金，

sentences.en: through January and February.
sentences.zh: 直到一月和二月。

sentences.en: And then, of course, Speaker Johnson's right back in the same position.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然，约翰逊议长又回到了同样的位置。

sentences.en: And if he does what he just did in the new year, I have to think that that is strike three for him.
sentences.zh: 如果他在新的一年里做了他刚才做过的事，我不得不认为那对他来说就是“三好球出局”。

sentences.en: And then his speakership could very much be over.
sentences.zh: 到那时，他的议长任期很可能就结束了。

sentences.en: Yes, we are essentially going to have to come back to the same place in January and then again in February.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们基本上不得不在一月份回到同样的地方，然后在二月份再次回到这里。

sentences.en: And I think the reality is every time Speaker Johnson faces a new government funding deadline, it gets worse for him, because now he has these rising expectations to manage.
sentences.zh: 我认为现实情况是，约翰逊议长每面临一个新的政府拨款截止日期，情况对他来说就越糟糕，因为现在他有这些不断上升的期望需要管理。

sentences.en: He has the Freedom Caucus getting increasingly upset with him.
sentences.zh: 他有自由核心小组对他越来越不满。

sentences.en: And in an attempt to assuage the Freedom Caucus, he said to them prior to passing this bill, look, I'll never do this again.
sentences.zh: 为了安抚自由核心小组，他在通过这项法案之前对他们说，看，我永远不会再这样做了。

sentences.en: I will not put a short-term spending bill on the floor again.
sentences.zh: 我不会再把短期支出法案提交到议会大厅了。

sentences.en: But that's a really hard promise to keep, because either you keep the promise, you refuse to
sentences.zh: 但这是一个非常难以兑现的承诺，因为要么你遵守承诺，拒绝

sentences.en: put a stopgap spending bill on the House floor, and that potentially puts you down the road
sentences.zh: 把临时支出法案提交到众议院，那可能会让你走上

sentences.en: of shutting the government down, if not fully, at least partially shutting the government down.
sentences.zh: 政府停摆的道路，如果不是全面停摆，至少也是部分停摆。

sentences.en: But if he decides to try to keep the government open by advancing, again, a short-term spending
sentences.zh: 但如果他决定通过再次推进短期支出

sentences.en: bill and using Democrats to pass that, then he's just broken a promise to the House Freedom
sentences.zh: 法案并利用民主党人来通过它以维持政府运作，那么他就违背了对众议院自由核心

sentences.en: Caucus.
sentences.zh: 小组的承诺。

sentences.en: And we've seen how they react when speakers break their promises.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到了当议长违背承诺时他们的反应。

sentences.en: Now, on the other hand, I do think that we need to think about the possibility that maybe, just maybe, going forward, the Freedom Caucus cuts him a little more of a break than they
sentences.zh: 另一方面，我确实认为我们需要考虑这样一种可能性，也许，仅仅是也许，未来自由核心小组会比他们

sentences.en: cut Kevin McCarthy.
sentences.zh: 对待凯文·麦卡锡时对他稍微宽容一点。

sentences.en: And I think a big part of this was that a lot of the antipathy the Freedom Caucus had toward Kevin McCarthy, it was substantive, it was about the policies that he was putting
sentences.zh: 我认为其中很大一部分原因是，自由核心小组对凯文·麦卡锡的许多反感是实质性的，是关于他提出的政策，

sentences.en: forward, but it was also really personal.
sentences.zh: 但同时也确实非常个人化。

sentences.en: That just doesn't exist in the same way for Mike Johnson.
sentences.zh: 这种情况在迈克·约翰逊身上并不以同样的方式存在。

sentences.en: And so I think that really injects an unknown variable into the calculus of what happens as
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这确实给迈克·约翰逊在试图维持政府运作的同时试图让自由核心小组满意这一过程的计算中，注入了一个未知变量，

sentences.en: Mike Johnson goes down this road of trying to keep the government open at the same time he's trying to keep the Freedom Caucus happy, simply because sometimes the calculation can
sentences.zh: 仅仅是因为当你相信掌权的人是你们的一员时，计算方式有时会发生变化。

sentences.en: change when you believe that the guy who's in charge is one of you.
sentences.zh: 所以你所唤起的，非常迷人且非常理论化的，是一个极右翼

sentences.en: So what you're evoking, which is very fascinating and very theoretical, is a world in which far-right
sentences.zh: 共和党人反复容忍约翰逊议长在某种意义上在预算问题上出卖他们的世界。

sentences.en: Republicans tolerate Speaker Johnson repeatedly, in a sense, selling them out on budgets.
sentences.zh: 如果这种情况发生而他们没有罢免他，那么这意味着约翰逊做了一些非常了不起的事情。

sentences.en: And if that happens and they don't oust him, then that will mean that Johnson has done something pretty remarkable.
sentences.zh: 他不仅在从议员到议长的转变中超越了自己的政治本能，

sentences.en: He's not just risen above his own political instincts in his transition from member to speaker,
sentences.zh: 而且他还以某种方式说服了这些其他极右翼共和党人，在某种意义上，也做了同样的事情。

sentences.en: but he's somehow convinced these other far-right Republicans to, in a sense, do the same.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为有一种思想流派认为，自由核心小组的一些要求，或者说许多要求，在目前看来是根本不可能实现的，

sentences.en: Well, I think there's a school of thought out there, which is that some of the demands, or rather many of the demands of the Freedom Caucus, are simply impossible right now,
sentences.zh: 考虑到白宫里有民主党人，而且民主党控制着参议院，

sentences.en: given the fact that there's a Democrat in the White House and that Democrats control the Senate,
sentences.zh: 也许需要他们自己人成为议长，他们才能最终意识到，我们就是无法让这些事情发生。

sentences.en: that maybe it's going to take one of their own becoming Speaker for them to finally realize, we just can't have these things happen.
sentences.zh: 但我认为还有另一个变量在起作用，那就是我们刚刚看到了当自由核心小组决定罢免议长时会发生什么。

sentences.en: But I also think there's another variable at play here, which is that we just saw what happens when the Freedom Caucus decides to oust the Speaker.
sentences.zh: 那是一段我们所有人都经历过的可怕的三周。

sentences.en: That was a terrible three weeks that we all went through.
sentences.zh: 众议院陷入了瘫痪，一片混乱，共和党人因此每周都登上糟糕的头条新闻。

sentences.en: The House floor was paralyzed, it was chaos, and Republicans were getting terrible headlines week after week because of it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道是否有人，即使是自由核心小组的人，特别渴望再次回到那种状态。

sentences.en: I don't know that anyone, even those in the Freedom Caucus, are particularly eager to return to that status again.
sentences.zh: 因此，虽然在此期间，他们已经明确表示他们会试图让他的日子更难过，他们会试图以所有这些小方式惩罚他，

sentences.en: And so, while in the interim, they've made clear that they're going to try to make his life harder, that they're going to try to punish him in all these small ways,
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为存在一种可能性，归根结底，如果约翰逊能够保住这份工作，那不一定是因为自由核心小组

sentences.en: I do think there's a possibility where, at the end of the day, if Johnson is able to keep the job, it's not necessarily going to be because the Freedom Caucus
sentences.zh: 对他所做的事情感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: is so thrilled with how he's doing.
sentences.zh: 那是因为他们基本上无法忍受罢免另一位议长。

sentences.en: It would be because they essentially can't bear dethroning another Speaker.
sentences.zh: 好的，凯蒂，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Well, Katie, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他内容。

sentences.zh: 表示。

sentences.en: and would institute a days-long pause in fighting.
sentences.zh: 并会促成战斗暂停数日。

sentences.en: What I can say about this at this time is we think that we are closer than we have been, perhaps at any point, since these negotiations began weeks ago,
sentences.zh: 目前我能说的是，我们认为双方比几周前谈判开始以来的任何时候都要接近达成协议，

sentences.en: that there are areas of difference and disagreement that have been narrowed, if not closed out entirely, but that the mantra that nothing is agreed until everything is agreed
sentences.zh: 尽管在某些领域仍存在分歧和争议，但这些分歧已经缩小，甚至可能已完全消除，不过“在一切达成一致前，什么都没有达成一致”的原则，

sentences.en: certainly applies here to such a sensitive negotiation, and there is no...
sentences.zh: 对于如此敏感的谈判当然适用，目前还没有……

sentences.zh: 但随着战争持续，一位联合国

sentences.zh: 官员表示，该机构在加沙北部运营的两所学校被用作避难所，但在空袭中严重受损，

sentences.en: and video from one of the scenes, verified by the Times, showed many bloodied and motionless bodies at one of the schools.
sentences.zh: 经《纽约时报》核实的现场视频显示，其中一所学校内有许多血迹斑斑、一动不动的尸体。

sentences.en: Hamas officials blamed Israel for the attack.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯官员指责以色列发动了这次袭击。

sentences.zh: 与此同时，以色列表示正在评估相关情况。

sentences.en: On Sunday, John Feiner, a U.S.
sentences.zh: 周日，美国国家安全官员约翰·费纳

sentences.en: national security official, was asked about the schools by CNN.
sentences.zh: 在接受美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）采访时被问及这些学校的情况。

sentences.en: What I can say at this point, and we're also in touch with the Israelis to try to find out what they know
sentences.zh: 目前我能说的是，我们也在与以色列方面联系，试图了解他们所掌握的

sentences.en: about what happened, is that if harm was done to innocent civilians sheltering at a U.N.
sentences.zh: 关于事件发生经过的信息，如果躲避在联合国

sentences.zh: 在一场戏剧性且令人意外的人事变动中，ChatGPT（这款具有影响力的人工智能软件背后的公司）的董事会
